system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the agent logic is encapsulated in acontext manager(described in Section 6.2.1) that composes prompts from the current state
system_prompt_style.note: Experience snippets injected per template {system prompt}<EXP>{exp g}</EXP>{query} in experience-guided rollouts.

env_context_strategy.note: Environment profiles used in self-questioning exploration only; agent interacts via environment tool APIs.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: When its size exceeds a predefined threshold, the Context Manager summarizes older content into a compressed memory messageand initializes a new timeline window for subsequent interactions.
context_compaction.note: Sliding-window and self-context-managing templates are selectable; basic causal template keeps full history. Default template not established from evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent then repeats the observe–act cycle until termination
loop_primitives.note: Training framework runs a master four-stage loop; paper says planner–executor achievable by modifying the context manager (code change).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: structured prompts encourage the model to generate <think> tokens before decisions

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each worker interacts with the environment to initialize instances, execute actions, and collect observations, and with the model to assemble prompts and invoke the LLM in sequence
multi_agent_topology.note: Game Arena (Avalon/Diplomacy) is a multi-agent peer setting in games/.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each worker interacts with the environment to initialize instances, execute actions, and collect observations, and with the model to assemble prompts and invoke the LLM in sequence

human_in_loop.note: Game Arena allows human to participate as a player.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Live Context Timeline (LCT)— a mutable sequence representing the agent’s current working context during multi-turn interaction.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: vector store updating, where validated task experiences are indexed and integrated into the long-term experience storage for subsequent retrieval
long_term_memory.note: ReMe experience pool is optional (examples/overall.yaml); basic.yaml runs without ReMe.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we offer an LLM-based judge as a fallback proxy for Freward
self_verification.note: Judge provides training reward rather than in-run verification.

termination_condition.note: Rollout manager 'defines termination criteria' without detail.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: AgentEvolver adopts a service-oriented dataflow architecture, seamlessly integrating environment sandboxes, LLMs, and experience management into modular services.
execution_isolation.note: Environment runs as a separate env-service process (e.g. AppWorld); local host service rather than cloud.

tracing.evidence_quote: Structured logs: all companion logs live under `logs/companion/`
tracing.note: Rollout log viewer (LogView) also available; per-step structure not confirmed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Start the main training or evaluation process

target_domain.evidence_quote: Standardized interfaces for seamless integration with a wide range of external environments and tool APIs.
target_domain.note: AppWorld/BFCL tool use; games arena as other; WebShop env service also shipped.
